{
  "name": "catchup",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "Summarize the agent messages you have not read, in plain ASD-STE100-style English. Run /catchup, type \"brief me\", or press the Catch up button.",
  "license": "MIT",
  "author": {
    "name": "Yanir",
    "url": "https://yanirrot.com"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Yanir-R/catchup",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Yanir-R/catchup",
  "userConfig": {
    "threshold": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Button threshold",
      "description": "Show the Catch up button when this many messages are below the screen.",
      "default": 8
    },
    "afkMinutes": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Away minutes",
      "description": "After this many minutes without a prompt from you, show the button even for 1 new message.",
      "default": 10
    },
    "model": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Summary model",
      "description": "Model alias or id used for the summary.",
      "default": "haiku"
    }
  },
  "keywords": [
    "summary",
    "catch-up",
    "agents",
    "handoff",
    "simplified-english",
    "claude-code",
    "unread",
    "sdlc",
    "adlc",
    "agentic-workflow",
    "agent-oversight",
    "human-in-the-loop"
  ],
  "icon": "./.claude-plugin/icon.png",
  "displayName": "Catchup: unread agent summary",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/Yanir-R/catchup#privacy",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/Yanir-R/catchup/issues",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/Yanir-R/catchup#readme"
}
